dialogue_texts: Ugh... your magic is completely absurd.
Brute-forcing your way through shifting axes with raw firepower shouldn't even be possible...
Heh, if a door's locked and the key keeps changing, you just gotta blow down the whole wall!
Now, spill it. Why are you messing with the pathways around here?
I am trying to prevent an architectural collapse, you dense thief.
This manor is caught in a severe temporal drift, slipping through multiple parallel timelines at once.
That explains why the surrounding coordinates felt completely detached from the local geography.
I deployed the inversion charms to keep the glohm from crushing the inner grounds before the core stabilizes.
But since you've completely shattered my boundaries, the way to the center of the anomaly is wide open.
Sounds like there's some seriously rare treasure or a massive magic source waiting at the center.
Don't lower your guard, My Majesty.
If the temporal anomaly is deep enough to warp reality this heavily...
Whatever is causing it at the center won't be easily managed.
